sprint: PDF PR #1 Merge, Post-Merge Verification, and Cross-Family Failure-Recovery Audit

questions.2_note: Excluded by allowlist. pdf.yml allowed_types=[Merger, TextExtractor]. Splitter not in list.
questions.3_note: Never reached generation stage. Blocked at scenario_planning by allowlist filter.
questions.4_note: Did not fail static validation, build, runtime, output validation, or reviewer. Was excluded BEFORE generation.
questions.5_excluded_before_or_after_failure: BEFORE generation. Prior runs (pre-allowlist restriction) showed generation failures.
questions.6_exact_root_cause: In prior runs (pilot-pdf-20260505-140928, 142605, 143724), the LLM consistently hallucinated the abstract base class 'PluginOptions' instead of the concrete 'SplitOptions'. The generated code instantiated 'new PluginOptions()' which does not compile (abstract class). Even when forced to compile (via user-defined local class), the resulting code was not a valid LowCode API demonstration. Splitter was subsequently removed from the allowlist to de-risk the pilot.
questions.7_limitation_category: LLM behavior — prompt insufficient to constrain the LLM to use the concrete SplitOptions class. Also missing: SplitOptions few-shot example, concrete options class validator, SplitOptions-specific prompt constraints.
8_system_fix_required: Add SplitOptions few-shot example to LLM prompt packet
Add prompt constraint: 'For Splitter, use SplitOptions (not PluginOptions)'
Add code validator rule: reject code containing 'new PluginOptions()'
Add repair feedback for PluginOptions hallucination
11_needed_for_next_pr: Build and runtime validation must pass
